forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, teams completed 4 visits and 2 clearances, with 36 team-days worked and 4 lost to rain or wind. So far, 15 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, and 12 areas released; 6 areas have been cleared, and mines were found in 3 areas.

No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No reports or dossiers were held or queried. The access feed shows 7 zones closed. No new plan was approved; the plan is P05.

The forecast, made in week 19 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is already done, gives a range of 10 to 13 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 14 zones declared free this season.
